verdict_rule: jev_judge.decide(answers, roles, 0.0, kind); prohibition anchors gate on relevant+contradicted only

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Every step of the formula is dispatched to an agent role (dev, qa, lead, publisher); decisions and stops are sent to omega-prime@hermes and no step waits for a reply from Rand.

cases.rationale: Approved pass fixture: no step waits on Rand.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: The release step pauses and asks Rand to confirm whether to cut a patch release before it continues.

cases.rationale: Approved fail fixture: release step waits for Rand's confirmation, which ANC-001 forbids.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Release step: the publisher agent cuts the patch release on its own once the PRs are merged. Any question it has is sent to omega-prime@hermes and the step continues on the documented default without waiting for a reply from Rand.

cases.rationale: Explicitly does not wait on Rand; questions go to omega-prime without blocking.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Release step: the publisher agent tags the release candidate and publishes the patch release to crates.io after the PR to main is merged.

cases.rationale: A run step (in scope) that never waits on input from Rand; waiting on the merge is the stated exception. Silence is compliance for a prohibition.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: If CI fails twice on the upgrade branch, the lead stops the run and waits for Rand to say whether to continue or abandon the upgrade.

cases.rationale: A step that waits for Rand's decision, not a merge.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: When CI on the PR to main is green, the lead sends `atm send omega-prime@hermes` asking Rand to merge it; the publish step starts after Rand merges the PR.

cases.rationale: Waiting for Rand's merge of the PR to main is the explicit exception in ANC-001.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Before tagging, the lead sends `atm send omega-prime@hermes` asking Rand which version number to use, and waits for his answer before continuing.

cases.rationale: Routing through omega-prime does not remove the wait for Rand's input (not a merge); still forbidden.

item.title: sc-lint-boundary change
item.text: Add a rule to the sc-lint-boundary crate that reports wildcard imports (`use foo::*`) in library crates, with unit tests and a documentation entry. No dependency, CI or release tooling changes.

cases.rationale: Not part of an sc-compose upgrade run.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Deliverable 1 bumps SC_COMPOSE_PIN in .claude/lib/sc_compose_dependency.py; deliverable 2 edits only the repo-owned files the changelog requires; owned_paths lists only these.

cases.rationale: Approved pass fixture.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: The upgrade step also refactors the bead templates, rewrites the README and reorganises .claude/lib while bumping the pin.

cases.rationale: Approved fail fixture: refactors and rewrites unrelated files during the upgrade.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: The upgrade edits two or three files: the pin constant in .claude/lib/sc_compose_dependency.py and whichever repository files the new sc-compose changelog says must change. No other file is edited.

cases.rationale: States the exact file restriction.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Upgrade step: the dev agent updates the sc-compose dependency to the target version and runs the full test suite before pushing the branch.

cases.rationale: Changes files for the upgrade but states no file restriction; nothing conflicting.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Deliverable 2: the dev agent reads the sc-compose changelog for the new version and summarises it in the bead notes.

cases.rationale: Mentions the changelog but not the only-these-files constraint.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: While bumping the sc-compose pin, the dev agent also upgrades every other Python dependency in the repository to its latest version.

cases.rationale: Changes files that neither reference sc-compose nor are required by its changelog.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: The new sc-compose changelog renames the `--check-render` flag, so deliverable 2 updates the two repository scripts that pass that flag; together with the pin bump these are the only files changed.

cases.rationale: Changelog-required edits are explicitly allowed by ANC-002.

item.title: sc-lint-boundary change
item.text: Add a rule to the sc-lint-boundary crate that reports wildcard imports (`use foo::*`) in library crates, with unit tests and a documentation entry. No dependency, CI or release tooling changes.

cases.rationale: Not an sc-compose upgrade.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: On a BREAKING verdict the pr_develop step leaves the develop PR ready to merge, closes the release bead as not planned and opens no PR to main.

cases.rationale: Approved pass fixture.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: On a BREAKING verdict the run abandons the branch without opening a PR to develop.

cases.rationale: Approved fail fixture: BREAKING path ends without a develop PR.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: If the impact assessment says BREAKING, the run finishes the work, leaves the PR to develop open, green and ready to merge with the impact assessment attached, and stops; no release PR to main is created.

cases.rationale: Both required outcomes on the breaking path.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: pr_develop step: the lead opens the PR from the upgrade branch to develop and waits for CI to finish.

cases.rationale: Touches the develop PR but says nothing about the breaking-change path.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Decision point 1: the lead reads the impact assessment and classifies the upgrade as BREAKING or non-breaking.

cases.rationale: Names the breaking verdict but not what the run must do on it.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: On a BREAKING verdict the run still opens the release PR to main after the PR to develop, with a warning in the PR description.

cases.rationale: Opens a release PR to main on a breaking change.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: On a non-breaking verdict the run opens the release PR to main after the develop PR merges; on a BREAKING verdict it stops with the PR to develop ready to merge and opens no PR to main.

cases.rationale: Release PR to main only on the non-breaking branch; the breaking branch complies.

item.title: sc-lint-boundary change
item.text: Add a rule to the sc-lint-boundary crate that reports wildcard imports (`use foo::*`) in library crates, with unit tests and a documentation entry. No dependency, CI or release tooling changes.

cases.rationale: Not an sc-compose upgrade.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Decision point 1 sends `atm send omega-prime@hermes` with the BREAKING or CI-green message; decision point 2 sends `atm send omega-prime@hermes` when the release is deferred.

cases.rationale: Approved pass fixture.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Decision point 2 checks for other work in progress and silently closes the release bead when release is deferred.

cases.rationale: Approved fail fixture: a decision point closes 'silently', i.e. explicitly without the required message.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: At decision point 1 the lead runs `atm send omega-prime@hermes` with the verdict; at decision point 2 the lead runs `atm send omega-prime@hermes` with the release decision.

cases.rationale: Explicit instruction at every decision point.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Decision point 1: if the impact assessment is BREAKING, take the stop path; otherwise continue to the release path.

cases.rationale: A decision point with no messaging instruction; nothing says no message is sent.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Each decision point records its outcome in the bead notes so the run can be audited later.

cases.rationale: About decision points but lacks the omega-prime instruction; recording notes does not exclude messaging.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Decision points send no messages; the lead records the chosen branch in the bead notes and continues.

cases.rationale: Explicitly rules out the required message.

item.title: sc-lint-boundary change
item.text: Add a rule to the sc-lint-boundary crate that reports wildcard imports (`use foo::*`) in library crates, with unit tests and a documentation entry. No dependency, CI or release tooling changes.

cases.rationale: Not an sc-compose upgrade.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: If an environment will not install, the dev records the refusal and sends the reason with `atm send omega-prime@hermes`.

cases.rationale: Approved pass fixture.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: If an environment will not install, the dev messages the team-lead and waits.

cases.rationale: Approved fail fixture: escalation routed to team-lead instead of omega-prime.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Any step that cannot proceed (a failed install, CI still red after two fixes, missing credentials) escalates with `atm send omega-prime@hermes` stating the blocker.

cases.rationale: All escalations to omega-prime via atm send.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: If the environment will not install, the dev records the refusal in the bead notes.

cases.rationale: Escalation situation with no destination stated; no conflicting recipient.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: The dev escalates install failures.

cases.rationale: Mentions escalation without the required channel or recipient.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Escalations from the run go to team-lead@sc-lint with `atm send team-lead@sc-lint`; omega-prime@hermes is not contacted.

cases.rationale: Different recipient, omega-prime explicitly excluded.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: When CI stays red after two fix attempts, the lead escalates with `atm send omega-prime@hermes` and stops the run.

cases.rationale: Escalation by the required command and recipient.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: When CI on the develop PR is green, the lead sends omega-prime@hermes "CI green. Rand, please complete <PR link>."

cases.rationale: Approved pass fixture.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: When CI on the develop PR is green, the lead merges the PR to develop itself.

cases.rationale: Approved fail fixture: the agent merges instead of asking Rand.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: Once CI is green on the PR to main, the lead runs `atm send omega-prime@hermes "CI green on <main PR link>. Rand, please complete the PR."` and does not merge it.

cases.rationale: Required notification on green CI for the main PR.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: pr_main step: the lead opens the release PR from develop to main and waits for CI.

cases.rationale: Protected-branch PR step with no green-CI notification; nothing conflicting.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: When CI is green on the PR to develop, the lead marks the step complete in the bead.

cases.rationale: Names the green-CI moment but not the required message.

item.title: upgrade-sc-compose formula step
item.text: When CI on the PR to main is green, the publisher enables auto-merge so the PR merges without Rand.

cases.rationale: Completes the PR without asking Rand.
